review.description: S1 rejects slow or failed ownership proof before activation while successful registration remains unchanged. S2 permits foreground management during callback work and ignores results belonging to canceled/replaced subscription generations. S3 real-host acceptance remains open.
review.implementation: Reviewed50ms bounded verification with32 retained actual-work slots, per-ID pending token ownership, cancellation checked under state lock, atomic Vault.SetTx activation and persisted opaque generations. Tick snapshots signing keys outside delivery I/O, serializes only background ticks and conditionally persists each matching generation; callback headers/body/close never hold shared state mutex. The HTTP handler captures originating bounded context as a value before SDK detachment; event mutations link cancellation to that origin for both2025 and2026 protocol clients, while accepted tool work and live streams keep their own lifetimes. Cycle2F6 restores one generation-conditional cursor commit for an ignored page or tail, with no signing-key snapshot for nonmatching events; matching callback delivery retains conditional per-result commits.
review.tests: Read noncooperative125ms header/body proofs,32-slot admission/actual exit, concurrent management, canceled queued request, stale200/503/410 suppression, failed refresh and rotated-key/cursor/retry assertions. Wire fixtures separately require successful list/management, existing callback error, Store.Write deadline rejection and actual SDK stream acknowledgement. Ordinary410 disable,429/permanent/exhaustion, disabled-setting no-replay, rotation expiry and restart gaps remain explicit. Ordinary TestEventStoreAdmissionPreservesRequestCancellation covers2025/2026 actual custom Subscribe/Unsubscribe with held125ms writer under response deadline and earlier caller cancellation, then Drain and exact original subscription-state assertions. This directly guards detached-origin SDK cancellation semantics. Read TestIgnoredEventPagesCommitOnceWithoutSigningMaterial: SQLite triggers prove one commit per100ignored events for unrelated, filtered and notification-disabled pages; nil vault forbids secret reads and empty re-ticks do not write. TestIgnoredPageCommitRejectsChangedGenerationAndDeletion races a real held writer with replacement/deletion and proves stale page commits neither overwrite nor resurrect. Disabled-setting cursor advancement is now asserted; re-enable no-replay and restart acceptance remain gaps. Reviewed the named pending-proof fixture: it exercises unrelated Subscribe/Unsubscribe and replacement/cancellation, while actual wire list contention is covered separately. The concurrent Tick fixture proves serialized callback delivery and foreground Subscribe/Unsubscribe; it does not supply an eligible later event to the removed peer, so its purpose makes no no-later-delivery assertion.
